verdict.rationale: Zero is a self-hostable email app with an MCP surface, so asking about versioned APIs and a deprecation policy is a fair question. The evidence shows no versioning scheme and no deprecation policy. The only API-adjacent material is MCP.md, a prose capability list with session-cookie auth and no endpoint schema, and an independent check found no public HTTP API or docs site.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
